answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a lock-up bond: each new agent identity must stake coins that stay frozen for many epochs, so creating one identity costs far more than cloning a handle. A thousand fake accounts therefore need a thousand real deposits, and each is slashed if a peer challenge fails. Like shale layers, identities stack slowly; the bond is the bridge between reputation and cash, and verified work is the quartz that proves the stake was earned.
